brief: Ocean-front 4-star hotel and spa in Biarritz, France, marketed to international travellers. “Winter Escape” offer: 2 nights + spa access + 60-min treatment, from €420 for two, November to March. Target: couples 30–60, affluent. Channel: YouTube + Instagram + website.
angle: Contemplative: horizon, sunset light in gradients, slow generative waves, fine typography.
